data_fields.name: status_base
data_fields.donor_constant: probability_value per skill (db row: ShockStun 50, Entangle 50, EarthBind 40, ThunderGrab 50)

data_fields.name: dice_per_gap
data_fields.donor_constant: probability_dice / 10 x trunc(level gap / 2) (dice 30 on Entangle, Earth Bind)

data_fields.name: hit_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 x original magic hit for a player attacker

data_fields.name: per_status_resist
data_fields.donor_constant: target resist per status (sustain, stun x2, stone, sleep, freeze, blind); absent for 8 group-A skills

data_fields.name: mr_band
data_fields.donor_constant: MR <= 100: 1 - 0.01 x floor((MR - hit)/2); above: 0.6 - 0.01 x floor((MR - hit)/10)

data_fields.name: element_resist_scale
data_fields.donor_constant: int(0.32 x |r|) / 32, sign kept (sketch uses r / 100)

data_fields.name: crit_base
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 percent + crit stat, skill level <= 6, x1.5

data_fields.name: counter_uses
data_fields.donor_constant: one use: effect removed on the first hostile spell

best_idea: A status spell is one roll against a chance built from the spell's base value, a level-gap term, and the target's resist, with a hard cap, and one shared damage pipeline (dice, stat coefficient, element, crit, flat reductions, then a magic-resist percentage) so every spell reads the same way.
decision_why: The one-roll chance and the MR percentage band fit a fast many-vs-one fight and a shared resolve step; the donor misses the resist on eight status spells, uses integer division in Thunder Grab, caps the unresistable spells at 90, quantises element resist, and its INT term scales to about x3.6, so the idea is kept and those defects are fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: A status spell at a +10 level gap against a target with a stated resist shows the chance as base plus gap term minus resist (visible in the cast log), never above 90%; a server test asserts that Entangle-type spells subtract the resist like Earth Bind does, and that Thunder Grab at 40 vs 50 uses the ratio.
